teaser: Encrypted, versioned vaults as the way data gets into, out of and between CI jobs, with a key per job and a sidecar when there is no server.
core_idea: A CI pipeline needs a versioned, encrypted record that outlives its runs and can be read outside GitHub, and sgit vaults provide it: jobs push and clone only their folders with --path, keys rather than scopes set what each job may do, append lanes collect shard results write-only, per-job key pairs make wiring mistakes fail loudly, and a sidecar server with a cached ciphertext folder removes the need for a hosted server.

nodes.label: Three exits, none a record
nodes.summary: Artifacts, caches and outputs each have limits on size, life and reach, and none is versioned or readable outside GitHub.

nodes.label: Data in and out
nodes.summary: A job pushes outputs; anyone with the read key clones them with history, from anywhere.

nodes.label: Jobs talk through the vault
nodes.summary: Each job clones only its folders; release never downloaded the build archive.

nodes.label: --path is speed, not a wall
nodes.summary: A scoped clone limits what lands on the runner; a vault key can widen it.

nodes.label: Keys are the boundaries
nodes.summary: Vault key, read key, append token, own key pair; the server token is only the door.

nodes.label: A read-key clone refused to commit
nodes.summary: Read and write keys are derived separately; a read clone holds no write key.

nodes.label: Append lanes for shards
nodes.summary: One token per shard, write-only inboxes, a separate key to list; wrong keys refused with 403.

nodes.label: A key pair per job
nodes.summary: Encrypt to the deploy job, sign the manifest; wrong job cannot decrypt, a changed file fails verification.

nodes.label: Wiring mistakes fail loudly
nodes.summary: Even with keys held loosely, a step that reads what was not meant for it fails instead of leaking.

nodes.label: Keys on stdin, bare only
nodes.summary: Keys from secrets via sgit clone -, and only .sg_vault/bare is ever cached or uploaded.

nodes.label: A sidecar and cached ciphertext
nodes.summary: The server as a container in the job; its storage archived and restored with full history.

nodes.label: Reading needs no server
nodes.summary: Local, static and attach read a vault from a folder; pushing needs the server's API.

nodes.label: A workflow sketch
nodes.summary: Two jobs, a vault key for build and a read key for release, keys from secrets.

quotes.text: A configuration that only the deploy job can decrypt is a bug that cannot ship to the wrong place.
quotes.why: Per-job keys as a correctness tool.

quotes.text: So the folder can live wherever a CI system keeps bytes
quotes.why: Why ciphertext storage removes the hosted server.
